title: Showroom Manager
description:
**Company Description**

**Jayalakshmi Silks**
is one of South India’s most trusted and renowned textile retail chains, offering an extensive range of sarees, ethnic wear, western wear, and apparel for the entire family. Known for its commitment to quality, tradition, and customer satisfaction, Jayalakshmi Silks combines decades of heritage with modern retail excellence. With spacious showrooms across major cities, it provides a premium shopping experience that blends elegance, comfort, and style.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time role for a Showroom Manager. The Showroom Manager will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the showroom, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, and managing the sales team. Key duties include managing inventory, implementing promotional strategies, training staff, and maintaining a positive customer experience. This is an on-site role located in Palarivattom, Kochi.

* Drive showroom sales to achieve monthly and annual targets, ensuring effective execution of promotional and marketing strategies.
* Maintain high visual merchandising (VM) standards and ensure timely replenishment of stock across all sections.
* Coordinate with the purchasing team to manage inventory requirements and maintain optimal stock levels.
* Monitor and evaluate staff and section head performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Foster strong communication and coordination with section heads to promote a high-performance team culture.
* Ensure adherence to grooming standards and promptly address staff and customer issues.
* Oversee end-to-end store operations, including staff scheduling and floor coverage during weekdays and weekends.
* Enhance overall customer experience through proactive engagement and effective feedback management.
* Track and analyze customer walkouts to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare and present daily sales and department-wise performance reports.
* Organize structured induction training for new employees and facilitate continuous upskilling through senior staff.
* Follow up of Maintenance activities and ongoing implementation activities.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; a degree in Business Administration or Retail Management preferred.
* Minimum of
  **5 years’ experience**
  as a Store/Showroom Manager in a reputed retail organization.
* Proven experience managing a team size of
  **100+ employees**
  .

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong leadership, team-building, and people management skills.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical, and reporting abilities.
* In-depth knowledge of retail operations, sales management, inventory control, and customer engagement.
* Ability to identify and drive process improvements while maintaining a positive, customer-centric environment.
* Customer service, satisfaction, and experience-oriented mindset.
* Prior experience in the fashion or textile retail industry will be an added advantage.

title: Partner Implementation & Success Manager
description:
Partnerships & Operations
  
  
Partner Implementation & Success Manager
  
  
Kochi Onsite, with partner travel when required Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
The Partner Implementation & Success Manager will take ownership after a B2B partnership is approved or signed and ensure that the partner progresses successfully from agreement to operational launch. The role will serve as the central coordination point between the partner and DICHIT’s product, technology, marketing, customer-success and operations teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Create a structured implementation plan for every new B2B partner.
* Collect and validate company KYC, branch, registration, banking and programme information.
* Coordinate agreements, SOPs, policies, approvals and operating requirements.
* Map the end-to-end customer onboarding, payment, refund and support processes.
* Coordinate technical integrations, data exchange and testing with both teams.
* Maintain implementation trackers covering tasks, owners, deadlines and dependencies.
* Conduct regular partner review meetings and document decisions and action items.
* Coordinate programme listing and verify that approved information is displayed accurately.
* Prepare partner branches and employees through product and process training.
* Coordinate joint launch plans with growth, digital and creative teams.
* Define communication, escalation and grievance-handling channels.
* Monitor early partner performance, customer activation and operational issues.
* Track service levels, unresolved issues and partner commitments.
* Prepare weekly partner-health and implementation reports.
* Build trusted relationships with partner decision-makers and operational teams.
* Ensure an organised transition from implementation to ongoing partner management.

Candidate Profile
  
  

* Approximately three to six years of experience in implementation, partnerships, account management, project management, customer success or business operations.
* Experience managing B2B clients and cross-functional projects.
* Strong project-planning, documentation and stakeholder-management ability.
* Able to coordinate product, technology, marketing and operational teams.
* Comfortable managing multiple partners and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in fintech, banking, financial services, payments, KYC or SaaS implementation will be valuable.
* Comfortable preparing process documents, trackers and management reports.
* Willing to travel for partner meetings, branch training and launches.
* Fluency in English is required; Malayalam communication will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Time from agreement to operational launch
* Completion of partner onboarding requirements
* Programme-listing accuracy
* Closure of implementation action items
* Partner training and launch readiness
* Service-level adherence
* Early customer activation
* Partner satisfaction and engagement
* Number and age of unresolved issues
* Quality of documentation and reporting

title: Head of IT Operations
description:
**Job Title: Head of IT Operations**

**Location: Kochi (Onsite)**

**Permanent - Full Time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

The Head of IT Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for the end-to-end delivery and strategic management of Cyncly's internal IT operations across all regions. This role holds direct accountability for the full IT support pyramid — overseeing both the Service Desk (L1/L2) and Infrastructure Operations (L3) functions — ensuring that all Cyncly employees receive a high-quality, reliable, and secure technology experience.

As Head of IT Operations brings a broader strategic mandate: shaping the operational model, driving organizational maturity, managing vendor and stakeholder relationships, and acting as the senior internal IT authority at the Kochi site. The role requires an experienced, people-first leader who combines deep technical understanding with a strong service culture, ITIL discipline, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Organizational Management**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and mentoring to both the Service Desk (L1/L2) and Infrastructure Operations (L3) teams, building a unified, high-performance IT operations function.
* Define and own the staffing model, org structure, and succession planning for all teams under scope, ensuring the right skills are in place to meet current and future business demands.
* Establish clear performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and create individual development plans to grow talent within the team.
* Champion a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, technical excellence, and psychological safety across the IT operations function.
* Manage headcount planning and resource allocation in coordination with HR and senior IT leadership, including recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Service Desk (L1/L2) Ownership & Infrastructure Operations (L3) Oversight
* Act as the senior escalation authority for complex L3 incidents and problems, providing leadership during major incidents until full resolution.
* Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning practices are in place to maintain proactive operational awareness and prevent service degradation.
* Oversee the management of enterprise Linux environments, backup and recovery systems, Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, and related core infrastructure platforms.
* Drive infrastructure stability by anticipating component failure risks and ensuring resilient recovery procedures are documented, tested, and regularly rehearsed.

**ITIL Governance & ITSM Excellence**

* Serve as the primary process owner for Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Request Fulfilment, ensuring rigorous application of ITIL principles across both L1/L2 and L3 teams.
* Ensure the optimal and consistent use of FreshService across all operational workflows — Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Knowledge Management.
* Lead the Problem Management process end-to-end: ensuring RCAs are completed for all significant incidents, corrective actions are tracked to completion, and preventative measures reduce recurrence.
* Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for internal IT changes, ensuring all changes are risk-assessed, properly approved, and communicated to stakeholders.
* Develop, publish, and regularly review IT support policies, procedures, and standards, embedding information security principles into all service delivery activities.

**Continuous Service Improvement (CSI)**

* Own and drive the CSI agenda for internal IT operations, using data from FreshService, monitoring tools, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement themes and prioritise initiatives.
* Track and report on a defined set of operational KPIs and metrics (FCR, MTTR, SLA compliance, CSAT, change success rate) and present performance reviews to senior IT leadership on a regular cadence.

**Vendor, Stakeholder & Budget Management**

* Manage relationships with key IT vendors, service providers, and managed service partners — holding them to contractual SLAs and driving value from commercial relationships.
* Own the IT operations budget for the Kochi site, managing expenditure within approved limits and presenting accurate forecasts and variance analysis to IT leadership.
* Act as the primary IT liaison for business stakeholders in the Kochi office and APAC region, proactively communicating service updates, planned maintenance, and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with global IT leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and HR on cross-functional programmes that impact the internal IT environment.
* Support M&A activity as required, assisting with IT due diligence and the onboarding of new entities into Cyncly's internal IT services and support model.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 18–20 years of progressive experience in IT Operations and IT Service Management, with at least 5–7 years in a senior management role.
* ITIL Foundation certification is mandatory; ITIL Intermediate, ITIL 4 Managing Professional, or Expert certifications are strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing large, multi-tiered IT operations teams (L1 through L3) within a complex, global enterprise.
* Proven track record of driving operational excellence through ITIL process ownership, ITSM tooling, and measurable service improvements.
* Strong experience with FreshService or an equivalent enterprise ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, etc.).
* Experience managing IT budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement processes.

**Technical Knowledge:**

* End-User Computing: Deep understanding of EUC platforms, device management (Intune/JAMF), and workplace technology standards.
* Infrastructure: Solid working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure — Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, virtualisation (VMware/Hyper-V), networking, and backup/DR solutions.
* Cloud: Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments; Azure Administrator or equivalent certification is desirable.
* Monitoring & Observability: Experience with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Datadog, or equivalent.
* Security: Working knowledge of endpoint security, patch management, DLP, and IT security best practices; ability to embed security into day-to-day service operations.
* AI & Automation: Experience deploying or managing AI-assisted service desk tools, RPA, or automation solutions to improve operational outcomes.

**Core Competencies:**

* People Leadership: A proven people manager who inspires, develops, and retains talent; experienced in managing diverse, multi-functional teams across different seniority levels.
* Service Mindset: Genuinely passionate about delivering exceptional IT experiences to end users; sets the standard for customer service culture across the team.
* Strategic Thinking: Able to balance operational execution with longer-term planning; translates business priorities into actionable IT operations improvements.
* Communication & Influence: Strong communicator who can tailor messages for technical and non-technical audiences; able to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Analytical Rigour: Data-driven approach to decision-making; able to interpret operational metrics and translate them into meaningful insights and actions.
* Resilience & Composure: Calm under pressure, decisive in a crisis, and able to lead teams effectively during high-severity incidents or periods of organisational change.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: UKI Regional Contracts and Supplier Governance- Supervising Associate
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Clients & Industries
  
  
**Role Type**
UKI Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance
  
  
**Description**
**Business unit specific description – Clients & Industries – GDS UKI**
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
  
  
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the ‘Assistant Manager’ drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**

* Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
* Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
* Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
* Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
* Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
* Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
* Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
* Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
* Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
* Ariba supply chain management life cycle

* Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
* Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
* Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
* Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
* Business acumen and Adaptability – Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
* Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
* Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc
* Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
* MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
* Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc
* High degree of professionalism and integrity

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years’ work experience in professional services industry.
* Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.

**What We Look For**

* Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
* Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
* Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.

title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst - ServiceNow Alliance - Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst**
**Job Summary:**
The GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support for the ServiceNow Alliance within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role will help alliance leadership run an effective, insight-led and scalable operating model by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution of ServiceNow alliance initiatives across sell, build and deliver motions. The incumbent will work closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders to strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
* Provide ServiceNow alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators.
* Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
* Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
* Program manage ServiceNow partner tools, portals and operational processes, including partner portal access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
* Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support ServiceNow Market Development Fund processes, investment tracking, compliance monitoring, quarterly reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
* Support ServiceNow alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner distinction or specialization requirements and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
* Partner with onshore ServiceNow alliance enablement contacts on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
* Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**

* Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to ServiceNow, enterprise software, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
* Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
* Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
* Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
* Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
* Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**

* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
* Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, ServiceNow, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
* Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

**Experience:**

* 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise software partner operations; exposure to ServiceNow or comparable software alliance environments would be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience in reporting, dashboarding, content development, stakeholder tracking, or operational improvement initiatives would be beneficial.

title: Founder’s Office – Senior: Growth, Strategy & Partnerships
description:
Founder’s Office
  
  
Founder’s Office – Senior: Growth, Strategy & Partnerships
  
  
Kochi Onsite Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
The Founder’s Office – Senior: Growth, Strategy & Partnerships role is a high-ownership position covering business strategy, B2B partnerships, market expansion, growth planning and cross-functional execution. You will help the Founder evaluate opportunities, structure partnerships, plan market launches and ensure that critical initiatives move from discussion to execution. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on involvement. The successful candidate must be comfortable working with senior stakeholders while also managing detailed execution across internal teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Strategy
  
  

* Work with the Founder to define business priorities, growth plans, and execution roadmaps.
* Evaluate new markets, customer segments, channels, and partnership opportunities.
* Build business cases, commercial models, and decision-support analyses.
* Translate strategic priorities into measurable initiatives, timelines, and ownership.
* Establish management dashboards and conduct structured performance reviews.
* Identify business, operational, and execution risks before they affect launches.

B2B Partnerships
  
  

* Build and manage a pipeline of registered chit fund companies and strategic partners.
* Support or lead partnership discussions, product demonstrations, and commercial negotiations.
* Develop proposals, partnership structures, rollout plans, and executive presentations.
* Coordinate due diligence, documentation, agreements, and operating procedures.
* Maintain relationships with decision-makers and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure that signed partnerships progress towards implementation and customer activation.

**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Customer Relations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier professional training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, India, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. MIA is recognized as a leading provider of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, with a strong focus on international exam success and global employability. The academy offers specialized preparatory programs for major language tests and healthcare licensure exams, supported by experienced trainers certified by global bodies such as Cambridge and IDP. Using evidence-based teaching methods, digital tools, personalized coaching, and app-based learning, MIA supports both online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for learners across sectors including healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.
  
**Role Description**
The Customer Relations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at Medcity International Academy’s Kochi center. This role is responsible for overseeing the learner and customer experience, including handling inquiries, guiding prospective learners through course and exam options, and managing admissions and enrollments. The Customer Relations Manager will maintain regular communication with learners and families, resolve issues, gather feedback, and coordinate with trainers and administrative teams to ensure seamless service delivery. Daily tasks include managing front office interactions, updating CRM systems and records, preparing reports on customer satisfaction, supporting marketing and outreach activities, and assisting with events, orientations, and information sessions. The role also involves implementing customer service standards, identifying areas for service improvement, and contributing to initiatives that strengthen long-term relationships and institutional reputation.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, including the ability to handle inquiries, resolve concerns, and maintain a professional, learner-centric approach.
* Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written), with the ability to explain programs clearly and interact confidently with learners, families, and institutional partners.
* Solid organizational and administrative skills, including experience with record-keeping, scheduling, documentation, and use of CRM or student management systems.
* Basic understanding of education or training services, ideally with exposure to language proficiency or healthcare-related exams, and a strong interest in learner success.
* Proficiency in common digital tools and office software, with the ability to learn and use academy-specific platforms and app-based learning systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with trainers, counselors, and operations staff, while managing priorities and maintaining high-quality service in a busy on-site environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (education, business, communication, or related fields preferred) and prior experience in customer-facing roles, such as education counseling, front office management, or customer support.
* High level of professionalism, integrity,

title: Captain
description:
**Company Description**
TopForm Restaurant has been a culinary landmark in India since 1975, known for its diverse multi-cuisine menu and signature biryanis. The restaurant offers guests a rich gastronomic experience, blending classic recipes with contemporary flavors. Each dish is crafted to celebrate taste, tradition, and high-quality ingredients. Over nearly five decades, TopForm has built a reputation for consistent culinary excellence and warm hospitality, attracting both local guests and visitors.

**Role Description**
The Captain at TopForm Restaurant is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, responsible for supervising daily front-of-house operations. This role includes managing section allocations, guiding service staff, and ensuring guests are greeted, seated, and served efficiently and courteously. The Captain coordinates order taking, checks food presentation before it reaches the table, and addresses guest requests or concerns in a professional manner. Additional responsibilities include maintaining service standards, supporting reservations and table planning, training team members, and collaborating with the kitchen and management to deliver a seamless dining experience.

**Qualifications**

* Strong guest service and hospitality skills, with the ability to create welcoming and professional interactions.
* Experience in supervising restaurant floor operations, including team coordination and table management.
* Solid communication skills for effective collaboration with guests, service staff, and kitchen teams.
* Ability to handle busy service periods, multitask, and maintain attention to detail under pressure.
* Knowledge of food and beverage service standards; prior experience in multi-cuisine or casual fine dining is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in POS systems, order taking, and billing processes.
* Relevant experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry; a diploma or certification in Hotel Management or Hospitality is preferred.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, and to adhere to hygiene and safety standards.

* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Technical Program Head
description:
**Job Brief** 




 We are looking for an accomplished Technical Program Head with 14–20 years of experience in engineering leadership, technical program management, and large\-scale product/program delivery. The candidate should combine strong hands\-on technical understanding with exceptional delivery and program management capabilities, with expertise across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Physical AI, Robotics, AI infrastructure, and cloud\-native platforms. The role will be responsible for driving complex multidisciplinary engineering programs from architecture and planning through development, integration, validation, deployment, and production scale\-up. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple strategic AI, robotics, computer vision, and autonomous\-system programs. 
 



 • Lead program planning, technical execution, architecture reviews, milestones, dependencies, budgets, risks, and delivery commitments. 
 



 • Translate business and customer requirements into technical roadmaps, program plans, and measurable engineering outcomes. 
 



 • Establish technical governance, architecture standards, engineering best practices, and program delivery frameworks. 
 



 • Drive cross\-functional execution across AI/ML, computer vision, robotics, embedded systems, cloud/platform, simulation, QA, DevOps/MLOps, and hardware teams. 
 



 • Lead customer/Tier\-1 technical discussions, solution reviews, escalations, and delivery governance. 
 



 • Manage globally distributed engineering teams and engineering leaders. • Drive design and architecture decisions for scalable, reliable, real\-time, and safety\-critical systems. 
 



 • Establish program KPIs covering schedule, quality, cost, technical maturity, risks, engineering productivity, and customer satisfaction. 
 



 • Drive release planning, integration, validation, deployment, hypercare, and production stabilization. 
 



 • Identify technical and program risks early and establish effective mitigation and recovery plans. 
 



 • Mentor engineering managers, architects, technical leads, and program managers. 
 



 • Drive innovation, technology roadmaps, reusable platforms, IP creation, and engineering excellence. 
 



  





**Required Skills** 




  





**Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning** 




 • Strong expertise in AI/ML, Deep Learning, Foundation Models, Transformers, CNNs, multimodal learning, reinforcement learning, and multi\-agent systems. 
 



 • Experience with large\-scale model training, optimization, evaluation, and production\-grade AI/ML. 
 



 • Strong understanding of Generative AI, representation learning, self\-supervised learning, and scalable AI architectures. 
 



  





**Computer Vision \& Perception** 




 • Strong expertise in object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, depth estimation, and real time image/video analytics. 
 



 • Experience with YOLO, Vision Transformers, Faster R\-CNN, SSD, SLAM, multi\-view vision, 3D perception, and sensor fusion. 
 



 • Experience building and deploying robust perception systems for industrial, robotic, or autonomous applications. 
 



  





**Robotics \& Autonomous Systems** 




 • Strong experience in autonomous robotic platforms, wheeled/quadrupedal robots, and by wire/autonomous vehicle architectures. 
 



 • Expertise in state estimation, localization, motion planning, low\-level control, and hardware\-software integration. 
 



 • Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2, Autoware, and real\-time robotic/autonomous systems. 
 



  





**Program \& Delivery Management**

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:

 The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future\-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long\-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long\-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision\-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end\-to\-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.

* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross\-functional teams.

title: Head of Research and Development
description:
**Head of R\&D**
 Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks.
   

  

**About The Company**
 We're a Kochi\-based deep\-tech company building underwater robots for places people can't safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are moving from a strong engineering team to a company that ships scalable products, and we need a leader to build the R\&D engine that gets us there.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own technology and product development end to end and report to the CEO, CTO. This isn't a pure research role or a chief\-engineer role. You will turn customer and mission needs into reliable, manufacturable products, make R\&D delivery predictable, and build a team that doesn't depend on any one person, including you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Set the 2–3 year technology and product roadmap, and keep experimental work separate from committed deliverables.
* Lead programs from requirements and architecture through prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Strengthen systems engineering across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Build rigorous testing lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Turn every field failure into a lasting fix.
* Make every handover to production clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales on feasibility and estimates before commitments are made, and control scope creep from custom requests.
* Build the R\&D leadership team, succession depth and a technical career path alongside the management track.
* Own the R\&D budget, labs, vendors and partners. Protect IP and manage technology risk such as obsolescence and single\-source parts.
* Act as a senior member of the leadership team, not the head of a silo.


**You might be a fit if you have**
* 15\+ years in engineering and R\&D, including 5\+ years leading multi\-disciplinary product teams.
* Taken integrated hardware and software products from concept through validation and industrialization to field deployment.
* Background in robotics, autonomous systems, marine, defence or aerospace, embedded or industrial electronics (strongly preferred).
* Experience with mission\-critical, high\-reliability, government or defence requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor's or Master's in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.


**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**
* An assessment of the R\&D organization, active programs, technical debt and key\-person risks is complete.

 You will build frontier robotics that work in some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders, and shape an R\&D organization at a pivotal stage of growth.

 Kochi, Kerala. Full\-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Manager- Supplier Relationship Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) – Manager/Senior Manager**
 Supplier Relationship Management is responsible for actively managing strategic and key suppliers across the full contract lifecycle. From pre‑contract support through post‑contract execution, to protect value, reduce risk, and strengthen long term partnerships.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We're looking for a Manager/Senior Manager who will be responsible for the successful execution of supplier management activities across the contract lifecycle. The incumbent will manage commercial, contractual, performance and governance activities for strategic supplier engagements, ensuring supplier performance, contract compliance, service quality and value realization.
   

  

 This role requires strong analytical, commercial and presentation skills to develop executive dashboards, supplier scorecards, governance reports and leadership presentations. The successful candidate will work closely with the broader SRM team, Sourcing Managers, Global Procurement Executives, Vendor Risk \& Compliance Owners, Business Operations, EY IT, EY GCO, EY Finance and Supplier personnel to drive supplier performance management, service credit realization, invoice validation, change request governance, transformation initiatives, tool deployments, issue escalation management and continuous improvement while delivering measurable business value and fostering strong supplier relationships.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead strategic supplier relationships, governance forums, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive reporting to drive supplier performance, commercial outcomes and value realization.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and suppliers, aligning performance expectations, contractual commitments and service delivery objectives.
* Organize and facilitate governance meetings, leadership reviews and steering committees, including preparation of presentations, briefing materials, scorecards and executive dashboards.
* Drive supplier performance management through KPI/SLA reviews, service credits, performance scorecards and contractual compliance assessments.
* Manage supplier risks, critical issues, escalations and corrective action plans (CAPA), ensuring timely resolution and sustainable outcomes.
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations through supplier performance analysis, governance reporting and commercial reviews.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Risk, IT and supplier organizations to support governance, compliance, transformation and automation initiatives.
* Lead contract governance activities, including change requests, scope modifications, commercial reviews, invoice validation and value\-leakage prevention.
* Support supplier due diligence, financial reviews, internal controls, audit requirements and compliance assessments.
* Drive continuous improvement, supplier optimization and transformation initiatives, including operating model changes, transitions and reverse transitions.
* Lead post\-transition and post\-transformation hypercare activities to ensure service stabilization, stakeholder readiness and business continuity.
* Track governance actions, commitments and dependencies, ensuring accountability and timely delivery of agreed outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent analytical, critical\-thinking and decision\-making abilities.
* Experience in supplier governance, contract management, KPI/SLA management and service credit realization.
* Ability to advise senior leadership on supplier performance, risks and commercial opportunities.
* Strong commercial acumen with a data\-driven and fact\-based approach to problem\-solving.
* Ability to work independently across multiple suppliers, stakeholders and global teams.
* Proven capability to influence decisions, challenge assumptions and drive supplier accountability.
* Collaborative and culturally aware, with a focus on continuous improvement and value realization.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Procurement, Technology or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications and/or professional certifications are an advantage.
* 6\+ years of experience in Supplier Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Contract Governance or Commercial Management within global organizations.
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, supplier governance, contract compliance, commercial reviews and change request management.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to develop executive\-ready dashboards, reports and governance insights.
* Experience in KPI/SLA management, supplier performance reporting, transformation initiatives, process improvements and automation programs


**What We Look For**
* A person with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment.
* Opportunities to work with EY practices globally


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to lead end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise digital support services across web, mobile, and CRM (Salesforce) platforms. The role will be responsible for managing multi\-layered support operations (Monitoring, L1, L2, and Dev coordination), driving SLA adherence, operational governance, and continuous service improvement, while working closely with business and technology stakeholders.

 1\. Service Delivery \& Operations Management

* Drive structured daily operations governance (standups, backlog, SLA reviews)

* Automation rules
* SLA configurations

* SLA performance
* Resource productivity
* Queue health

* Understand functional and technical aspects including:
* Sales / Service processes
* Case management workflows
* Integrations and dependencies
* Coordinate with Dev teams for defect resolution and enhancements

* Oversee proactive monitoring and alert management
* Define SOPs for:
* Incident creation and prioritization
* Alert deduplication and handling
* Lead major incident management (war room / escalation governance)



  





 6\. Process Optimization \& Automation
 


* Drive continuous improvement initiatives including:
* SOP and Runbook standardization
* Knowledge Base maturity
* Lead implementation of:
* Virtual Agent (VA) / chatbot solutions for L0 automation
* Identify opportunities for:
* Auto\-remediation
* Reduction of repeat incidents
* Efficiency improvements

* Act as the primary interface for business and technology stakeholders
* Manage:
* Service reviews
* Executive reporting
* Escalation handling
* Provide insights and recommendations for service improvement

* Manage and lead 40–60 member distributed teams
* Ensure:
* Effective workload distribution
* Shift and capacity planning
* Performance tracking and mentoring



  





 9\. Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Develop and present dashboards covering:
* SLA performance (priority\-wise)
* Incident and Service Request trends
* Resource productivity
* Ensure data accuracy and actionable insights for stakeholders



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Strong experience in enterprise application support / managed services
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Jira Service Management (JSM)
* Salesforce support operations
* Proven experience managing large teams (40\+ resources)
* Strong understanding of:
* ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change)
* SLA management and service governance
* Experience in dashboarding and reporting tools
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management (business \& CXO level)



  





 Preferred / Good to Have
 


* Experience implementing Virtual Agent / chatbot solutions
* Exposure to AIOps / automation frameworks
* Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog or similar)
* Experience in digital platforms (web/mobile \+ integrations ecosystem)

title: Senior Manager - Channel Partnerships & Alliances
description:
**Role purpose** 




  





 The Senior Manager \- Channel Partnerships \& Alliances will build, activate and scale EyeROV's partner network. The role is responsible for identifying the right partners, onboarding and enabling them, developing joint account plans, and ensuring that partners consistently generate qualified sales opportunities alongside the concerned Regional Sales Managers (RSMs).
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**1\. Partner strategy, identification and onboarding** 




 • Develop the partner landscape by region, sector and partner type, including channel partners, system integrators, consultants, EPC contractors, technology partners and local representatives.
 



 • Evaluate potential partners for customer access, industry credibility, technical capability, geographic reach, commercial fit and conflict risk.
 



 • Lead partner discussions, commercial alignment, due diligence, contracting and structured onboarding in coordination with internal stakeholders.
 



 • Maintain a balanced portfolio of national, regional and sector\-focused partners aligned with EyeROV's growth priorities.
 



**2\. Partner enablement and activation** 




 • Create partner\-specific enablement plans covering target sectors, customer profiles, use cases, products, qualification criteria and routes to market.
 



 • Coordinate product, application and commercial training using presentations, case studies, demo support, proposal inputs and sales playbooks.
 



 • Ensure every onboarded partner has a defined account list, initial activity plan and path to the first qualified opportunity.
 



 • Build partner confidence to position EyeROV solutions accurately while protecting technical, pricing and brand integrity.
 



**3\. Joint pipeline creation and opportunity development** 




 • Develop joint business and account plans with partners and the concerned RSMs.
 



 • Drive partner\-led customer introductions, discovery meetings, demonstrations, tender intelligence and opportunity qualification.
 



 • Track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced opportunities in the CRM, with clear next actions, value, probability and expected closure date.
 



 • Support RSMs and partners through proposal development, commercial discussions, demonstrations and customer follow\-ups.
 



**4\. Partner engagement and governance** 




 • Run regular partner reviews covering activity, pipeline, open actions, support requirements and forecast movement.
 



 • Define partner tiers, performance standards, escalation paths and engagement cadence.
 



 • Address channel conflict, account ownership, lead registration, commercial alignment and partner conduct in a transparent manner.
 



 • Retain and deepen high\-performing relationships while recommending corrective action or deactivation for persistently inactive partners.
 



  





**Preferred sector exposure** 




 Experience in one or more of the following will be advantageous: marine technology, underwater systems, drones or unmanned systems, defence and homeland security, industrial automation, NDT/inspection, oil and gas, ports, hydro infrastructure, EPC projects, public\-sector sales or technology distribution.
 



  





**Working model with Regional Sales Managers** 




 • The role will operate in a matrix with EyeROV's regional sales organisation:
 



 • The Partnership Manager owns partner recruitment, onboarding, enablement, engagement and partner performance.
 



 • The RSM owns the end\-customer opportunity, regional sales forecast, proposal strategy and closure.
 



 • The Partnership Manager and RSM jointly own account planning, partner\-supported customer activity and pipeline progression.
 



 • Account ownership, commercial commitments and partner margins must be documented before significant opportunity investment.
 



  





**Candidate profile** 




 • 8\-15 years of experience in channel sales, partnerships, alliances, business development or enterprise sales.
 



 • Demonstrated experience recruiting, enabling and managing partners in industrial technology, defence systems, robotics, inspection solutions, capital equipment or adjacent sectors.
 



 • Strong understanding of B2B and/or B2G sales cycles, including multi\-stakeholder opportunities, tenders and technical\-commercial proposals.
 



 • Track record of converting relationships into qualified pipeline and revenue, with disciplined use of CRM and forecasts.
 



 • Ability to understand technical products and translate them into clear customer and partner value propositions.
 



 • Strong commercial negotiation, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently across India and, when required, internationally.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business or a related field; an MBA is desirable but not mandatory.
 



  





**Why join EyeROV** 




 • Be part of the fastest\-growing marine robotics deep\-tech company•
 



 • Help scale an Indian deep\-tech company solving complex underwater and maritime challenges.
 



 • Build a partnership function with direct influence on market access and company growth.
 



 • Work across defence, energy, infrastructure and maritime applications with a multidisciplinary team.
 



 • Shape a partner ecosystem for emerging marine robotics categories in India and global markets.
 



 • Equal opportunity statement: EyeROV values diverse perspectives and evaluates candidates based on merit, capability and alignment with the role.
