title: Manager – OFR  Operations
description:
**About Ocean Freight Operations**
 The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As the Manager of Ocean Freight Export/Import Operations, this role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Ocean Freight Export/Import. Your primary focus will be aligning with the business strategy, which includes developing and implementing strategic plans to optimize export/import operations. Additionally, you will be tasked with fostering a culture of operational excellence, optimizing resources, delivering an exceptional customer experience, and maximizing profitability—all while ensuring strict compliance with industry regulations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure cost\-effective, high\-quality export ocean freight operations at DGF OFR Stations, including satellite locations.
* Assist in procuring and managing cargo capacity effectively, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Procure and manage cargo capacity cost\-effectively, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure the smooth execution of export shipments in line with customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.
* Ensure regulatory compliance pertaining to AMS, ACI, ISF, and FMC filing.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate cost estimation, billing, ESI \& E\-Booking, milestone updating, CW1 tool utilization, file hygiene checks, timely file closure, and daily monitoring of station metrics report.
* Increase customer satisfaction (both internal/external) with best\-in\-class services.
* Achieve all set operational performance targets.
* Proactively communicate and handle operational irregularities.
* Efficiently manage customer complaints.
* Identify and address possible gaps to eliminate revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Release documents to customers as per agreed SOP/COP (Cash/Credit).
* Oversee vendor payment process.
* Conduct customer visits as and when required.
* Ensure timely submission of management reports.
* Support and encourage the BC specialization.
* Oversee gateway operations.
* Drive implementation of key initiatives.
* Drive and implement the First\-Choice initiative as assigned.
* Taking charge of supervising the team members for all relevant operations, efficiency optimization, and upholding the standards outlined in the 1F1O (one file, one operator) methodology.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with sales and customer service teams.


**Team Management**
* Develop a culture of quality, service excellence, flexibility, and cost consciousness.
* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.
* Check your Teams Station Metrics Widget, and ensure every file has an owner (1F1O).
* Lead the entire export operations team at DGF West OFR Stations, including satellite locations.


**COMPETENCIES**
**Functional Competencies**
* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge on the entire operational flow, from booking to documentation and customs clearance, ensuring efficient and timely movements.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks.

* Leadership and Team Management: Directing teams towards goals and optimizing productivity by promoting accountability.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.
* Strategic Planning: Developing and implementing strategic plans to achieve organizational objectives.


**WHO SHOULD APPLY?**
**Must Have**
* 8\-9 years of work experience in the shipping or logistics industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in any field required.
* Lead teams for operational excellence and a high\-performance culture.
* Effective written and verbal communication with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Promptly address operational challenges and make data\-driven decisions.


**Preferred**
* Master’s Degree
* Familiarity with Trade Laws \& Regulations.
* Knowledge of the Indian Export \& Import Trade, Trade Lanes/Routes, Commodities, and Major Players.

title: Assistant Manager - Inventory
description:
**Assistant Manager \-** 
**Inventory**
**Location :** 
 Angamaly
   

  

**Qualification :** 
 Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field
   

  

**Experience : 6\+** 
 years, preferably in inventory/warehouse management within a manufacturing or food/FMCG environment.
   

  

**About Bayfield**
 Bayfield Food Ingredients Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing food solutions company specializing in seasonings, culinary solutions, and food ingredients for the HoReCa and institutional markets.
   

  

 As Bayfield scales its operations, we are looking for a hands\-on Inventory Manager who will bring discipline, accuracy, and traceability to raw material, packaging, and finished goods inventory, supporting uninterrupted production and reliable order fulfilment.
   

  

 This position offers a strong opportunity for an inventory/warehouse operations professional to build robust systems from the ground up and grow into broader supply chain leadership as the organization expands.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 The Inventory Manager will be responsible for the accuracy, availability, and traceability of Bayfield's inventory across raw materials, work\-in\-progress, and finished goods. The role requires a hands\-on professional who enjoys building systems, tightening processes, and working closely with Procurement, Production, and QC in a fast\-growing entrepreneurial environment.
   

  

**Working Style**
 The Inventory Manager is expected to be a hands\-on professional who enjoys working in a fast\-growing business. The role requires ownership, attention to detail, and the willingness to work across functions to build robust inventory processes rather than operate within a large corporate structure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Inventory Manager will be the custodian of Bayfield's inventory accuracy and warehouse discipline, ensuring stock records, documentation, and logistics coordination are accurate, timely, and fully compliant at all times.
   

  

* Inventory Planning \& Stock Management
* Maintain optimal stock levels of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods.
* Plan replenishment cycles in coordination with Procurement \& Strategic Sourcing and Production.
* Implement and monitor FIFO/FEFO practices to minimize wastage and expiry\-related losses.
* Track slow\-moving and obsolete stock, and recommend corrective action.
* Warehouse Operations
* Oversee receiving, storage, put\-away, and dispatch across the warehouse.
* Ensure proper handling and storage conditions for temperature\- and humidity\-sensitive ingredients.
* Maintain warehouse layout, safety, and hygiene standards in line with food\-grade storage norms.
* Supervise day\-to\-day warehouse activities and staff task allocation.
* Documentation \& Traceability
* Maintain accurate batch/lot traceability records for all inbound and outbound stock.
* Ensure inventory documentation meets QC/FSQR compliance requirements.
* Maintain GRNs, stock ledgers, and dispatch documentation without gaps.
* Support internal and external audits with timely retrieval of records.
* Inventory Audits \& Reconciliation
* Conduct regular cycle counts and periodic full physical stock audits.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies between system and physical stock.
* Maintain stock accuracy within the agreed threshold (target: 98%\+).
* Procurement \& Logistics Coordination
* Coordinate inward logistics with vendors, tracking shipments and resolving delays.
* Liaise with Procurement \& Strategic Sourcing on reorder points and lead times.
* Coordinate outward dispatch with Sales/Customer Experience teams to meet order timelines.
* Costing \& Reporting
* Support accurate inventory valuation and stock reconciliation for Finance.
* Generate periodic inventory reports — stock ageing, turnover, wastage, and open orders.
* Present inventory MIS to the Operations Lead for management review.
* Team Supervision
* Supervise warehouse staff (Warehouse Incharge, Stacker Operators, and similar roles).
* Allocate daily tasks and monitor team performance.
* Train staff on inventory processes, safety, and hygiene practices.
* Systems \& Process Improvement
* Ensure effective utilization of inventory/ERP systems for stock tracking.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual errors.
* Support digitization of inventory records where applicable.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Work closely with QC/FSQR on compliance and inspection requirements.
* Coordinate with Production on material availability for planned batches.
* Support the Operations Lead with data for demand planning and forecasting.


**Desired Skills**
* Strong understanding of inventory and warehouse management practices.
* Working knowledge of ERP/inventory management systems.
* Proficiency in Excel for stock reconciliation and reporting.
* Understanding of FIFO/FEFO and batch traceability practices, ideally in food/FMCG.
* High attention to detail.
* Strong integrity and ownership.
* Leadership and team supervision experience.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-growing entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in inventory/warehouse management.
* Experience in food, FMCG, or ingredients manufacturing preferred.
* Experience managing a small warehouse team.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within the first 6–12 months, the Inventory Manager should:
   

  

* Achieve stock accuracy of 98%\+ between system records and physical inventory during audits.
* Ensure zero or near\-zero stockouts of critical raw materials that disrupt production schedules.
* Reduce wastage from expiry/spoilage consistently, quarter over quarter.
* Run inward and outward logistics on schedule, with delays flagged and resolved proactively.
* Deliver inventory reports (ageing, turnover, open orders) on time, giving the Operations Lead a reliable picture of stock health.
* Maintain batch/lot traceability that holds up cleanly during QC or compliance audits.
* Run a warehouse team that operates safely and efficiently, with low error rates in picking, storage, and dispatch.


**Career Opportunity**
* Bayfield offers a strong opportunity for an inventory/warehouse operations professional to grow with the organization. As the company scales, the role is expected to evolve into broader supply chain and operations leadership responsibilities, offering significant professional growth for the right individual.

description:
**Job Purpose**
 Achieving the Sales Targets, maintaining \& Increasing Market Share through incremental Sales \& new market development and ensuring highest level of Service standards channel partners \& their customers at the branch level
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 Job Context: Job Challenges:
   

  

 Organisation Context –
   

  

 Birla Sunlife Asset Management Company is one of the early entrants into the market with a 15 year history of Asset Management in India. It is a joint venture between the Aditya Birla Group and the Sun Life Financial Services Inc. of Canada.
   

  

**About The AMC Industry –**
 The Indian MF Industry has grown on the back of some really strong performance of the Indian equity market. However, it remains to be seen whether the industry has matured enough to handle the downside as well, when the performance of the market tapers, as it has since January 2008\.
   

  

 The long term outlook for Indian equities continues to remain positive, and going forward, equity returns are expected to track the earnings growth.
   

  

 There is an increased interest globally on India’s fast growing asset management business. This can also be witnessed with entry of new global players in the market and a number of other global players queuing up for licenses.
   

  

 Other important developments have been that there has been a rise in the percentage invested in equity products as compared to debt products in the last year and decision by SEBI to waive the entry load for investors making applications for investments in existing mutual fund schemes directly.
   

  

 AMC Market in India –
   

  

 The Indian mutual fund industry assets under management (AUM) settled at Rs. 7,62,502 Crores for October 2009\. Including fund of funds, the total AUM stood at Rs. 7,63,362 Crores as on October 2009\. The AUM as of March 2009 stood at Rs. 4,93,189 Crores.
   

  

 On the performance of the Mutual fund companies, As of October 2009, Reliance mutual fund is the countries largest private sector mutual fund house in terms of assets under management at Rs. 1,16,781 Crores, followed by HDFC mutual fund at Rs. 93,316 Crores, followed by ICICI Prudential at Rs. 80,524 Crores, UTI mutual fund is No. 4 in terms of AUM at Rs. 76,847 Crores BSLAMC is at No. 5 in terms of market position with Rs. 65,052 Crores.
   

  

 Job Context \-\-
   

  

 As a Branch Head, major role would be to drive sales at micro level, achieve sales target through Market penetration and increase service standards, thereby increasing Visibility and goodwill among channel partners and distributors to ensure Branch profitability. Also to identify and empanel untapped Channel partners and increase business output through meeting adequate training needs.

* Retaining mind share of TOP business partners in the competitive environment.
* Service issues due to poor infrastructure in upcountry markets. (Eg: Lack of awareness of Internet/ E\-Mail, Access issues through couriers)

 KRA1 Achieving sales targets and increasing market share of branch vis a vis industry. 1\.Maximising business in allotted territory through distribution channel (IFAs, Banks, PSU and NDs)
   

  

* Empanling and activation of untapped and potential Channel Partners

 KRA3 Identification \& Engaging of new Distribution channel partners. 1\.Developing new distributor relationships at branch
   

  

* Activation of such distributor relationships by providing timely and relevant info on schemes and the industry etc.


 KRA4 Monitoring Compliance to enable high alignment with systems and practices 1\.Ensuring that all regulations and statutory compliances are complied with
   

  

* Assist channel partners to adhere to compliances.

 KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster \& Zonal Head

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 Commercial / Contracts
 



**Direct report:** 
 Contract Manager/Contract Assistant
 



**Key interfaces:** 
 Senior leadership, Project Directors, Business Development, Finance, \& Bid Management Reporting), Legal advisers, Insurers, Clients, Sub\-Consultants
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The Senior Contracts Manager leads the company's contracts function and is accountable for how it manages contractual and commercial risk. The role sets the contract strategy, standards and governance for the team, negotiates and approves key contract terms, leads on variations, claims and disputes, and makes sure management receives accurate, timely contract information to support decisions.
 



  





 The Senior Contracts Manager line\-manages the Contract Manager/Assistant. Day\-to\-day contract administration is delegated to the Contract Manager, while the Senior Contracts Manager provides oversight, assistance with Contractual Agreements, approval, escalation and development of the team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Contract Strategy and Commercial Risk** 



* Review and advise on the contract terms of major bids and awards before signature, including scope, fees, payment terms, liability caps, indemnities, insurance, intellectual property and termination provisions.
* Lead negotiations with clients on high\-value, high\-risk or non\-standard contracts, and recommend acceptance, qualification or rejection of terms to senior leadership.
* Establish and maintain the company's risk appetite for contract terms, including approval thresholds and escalation routes.



  





**Governance, Standards and Approvals** 



* Own the company's standard contract templates, including SCAs, LOAs, PO terms and standard qualifications for proposals.
* Approve contracts, sub\-consultant agreements and variations above the Contract Manager's delegated authority.
* Set and enforce contract procedures, record\-keeping standards and data quality rules across the contract, award, bid and finance trackers, Cleverflow and Metabase.
* Carry out periodic audits of contract records and trackers to confirm accuracy and compliance.



  





**Variations, Claims and Disputes** 



* Lead the company's position on significant variation orders (VOs), fee adjustments, extensions of time and claims, making sure entitlement is protected and properly documented.
* Manage contractual disputes with clients and sub\-consultants, working with legal advisers where needed, and aim for negotiated resolution.
* Ensure lessons learned from disputes and claims feed back into contract templates and bid qualifications.



  





**Management Reporting and Decision Support** 



* Sign off the contract and award data prepared for the
 **weekly Wednesday management meeting** 
 , and present key issues, risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Give senior leadership oversight of the award pipeline, contract status, outstanding contracts and commercial exposure.
* Work with Finance leadership so that contract status and VO information support accurate WIP, revenue forecasting and cash\-flow planning.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the senior contractual point of contact for key clients, and the escalation point for long\-outstanding contracts or disputed matters.
* Manage relationships with legal advisers and insurers, including professional indemnity insurance requirements under client contracts.
* Support the Head of Bids and Business Development on the contractual aspects of bids, frameworks and joint ventures.



  





**Team Leadership and Development** 



* Line\-manage the Contract Manager, setting objectives, reviewing performance and supporting professional development.
* Oversee workload across the contracts team so that recurring deadlines (Friday bid tracker, Wednesday management pack) are consistently met.
* Build contract awareness across project teams through guidance and training on key contract obligations.
* Plan for resourcing and succession in the contracts function as the business grows.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




  




* Contract execution \- Percentage of awarded projects with fully executed contracts within the target period
* Commercial risk \- Contracts signed within approved risk parameters; number of exceptions approved
* Data accuracy \- Reconciliation discrepancies between, Cleverflow Metabase, trackers and finance records
* Reporting \- Management pack and bid tracker delivered on time every week
* Variations and claims \- Value and timeliness of VOs agreed; claims recovered
* Disputes \- Number, duration and outcome of contractual disputes
* Team \- Team performance, development and retention



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  





**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, Law or a related field. A postgraduate qualification in construction law or contract management is an advantage.
* 10–15 years of experience in contract or commercial management, including at least 5 years in a senior or team\-leading role, ideally within an engineering, design or construction consultancy.
* Proven track record of negotiating consultancy agreements and managing variations, claims and disputes.
* Substantial GCC/UAE experience, including work with government and major developer clients.



  





**Professional Membership (Desirable)** 



* MRICS, MCIArb, FIDIC certification, or equivalent professional recognition.



  





**Knowledge and Skills** 



* Expert knowledge of consultancy and construction contract forms, including the FIDIC suite (particularly the White Book for consultancy services) and bespoke client agreements.
* Good understanding of UAE/KSA contract and commercial law principles, professional indemnity insurance and liability management.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder management skills at senior level.
* Ability to interpret financial and commercial data and link it to contract positions.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including preparation of board\-level reports.



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Commercially astute, with sound judgement on risk.
* Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly in negotiations and disputes.
* Sets high standards for accuracy and governance,and leads by example.

title: Senior Manager – Moulding & Tool Maintenance
description:
**Position:** 
**Senior Manager – Moulding \& Tool Maintenance** 




**Department:** 
 Moulding
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Plant Head
 



**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala, India
 



**Position Summary:** 




 Provide strategic and operational leadership for a high\-technology, high\-volume Moulding operation supporting precision electronic connector manufacturing. Lead a manufacturing footprint of 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies with advanced automation.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance of the Moulding function, including manufacturing operations, process engineering, automation, capacity planning, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery, while building and managing a robust external moulding ecosystem through vendor development, job work, and purchase models.
 



 Develop a high\-quality, technically capable, cost\-competitive, and scalable moulding vendor network to support business growth, capacity flexibility, localization, and supply continuity. Establish strong technical and commercial governance for outsourced moulding, ensuring consistent quality, competitive total cost, delivery reliability, process capability, and adherence to global manufacturing standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. High\-Tech Moulding Operations** 



* Lead a high\-volume Moulding shopfloor comprising 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies.
* Drive performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, OEE, Productivity, Yield, and Capacity Utilization.
* Optimize moulding processes, cycle times, machine utilization, material consumption, changeovers, and process stability.
* Drive advanced automation, robotics, vision systems, process monitoring, and digital manufacturing solutions.
* Establish robust manufacturing standards to ensure consistent and capable processes.



  





**2\. Moulding Vendor Development \& External Manufacturing** 



* Develop and maintain a strategic network of capable moulding vendors to support internal capacity and business growth.
* Identify, evaluate, technically assess, qualify, and develop new moulding vendors based on technology, capacity, quality systems, process capability, scalability, and cost competitiveness.
* Develop vendors capable of meeting stringent requirements for precision electronic connector components.
* Establish structured vendor capability assessment, qualification, process validation, and performance\-monitoring systems.
* Develop alternate sources and a resilient vendor base to mitigate capacity, quality, and supply risks.
* Drive continuous improvement of vendor capability through technical support, process audits, quality improvement initiatives, and performance reviews.



  





**3\. Job Work \& Purchase Model Management** 



* Develop and implement appropriate job\-work and purchase models based on product characteristics, capacity requirements, cost competitiveness, and strategic sourcing considerations.
* Evaluate the optimal make\-versus\-buy / internal\-versus\-external manufacturing approach for moulding requirements.
* Establish clear commercial, technical, quality, and delivery expectations for outsourced moulding.
* Drive cost\-effective external manufacturing without compromising product quality, process capability, IP protection, delivery, or customer requirements.
* Monitor and optimize the overall economics of outsourced moulding, including conversion cost, material utilization, logistics, tooling utilization, and total landed cost.
* Ensure effective capacity allocation between internal operations and external manufacturing partners.



  





**4\. Vendor Quality \& Process Capability** 



* Establish stringent quality and process capability requirements for all moulding vendors.
* Drive First\-Time\-Right, defect prevention, process capability, yield improvement, and reduction of customer\-related quality issues.
* Conduct regular supplier process audits and capability assessments.
* Ensure effective implementation of PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, process validation, and structured problem\-solving at key vendors.
* Lead supplier corrective and preventive actions for quality and delivery issues.
* Establish vendor scorecards covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Capacity, Responsiveness, and Continuous Improvement.



  





**5\. Cost Competitiveness** 



* Drive a cost\-efficient moulding ecosystem through competitive sourcing, productivity improvement, process optimization, automation, and vendor development.
* Benchmark internal and external conversion costs and identify cost\-reduction opportunities.
* Develop competitive commercial models for job work and purchased moulded components.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to ensure transparency and competitiveness of moulding costs.
* Drive annual cost\-reduction and productivity initiatives across the internal and external moulding network.



  





**6\. Capacity \& Business Continuity** 



* Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term moulding capacity strategies aligned with business growth and customer demand.
* Balance internal capacity with external vendor capacity to provide flexibility, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Establish contingency and alternate\-source strategies for critical components.
* Ensure vendor capacity readiness for new product launches, volume ramps, and demand fluctuations.



  





**7\. New Product Introduction \& Industrialization** 



* Partner with Engineering, NPI, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for successful industrialization of new moulded connector components.
* Assess manufacturability and external manufacturing feasibility during product development.
* Lead vendor selection, capability assessment, trials, validation, and production ramp\-up for outsourced moulding.
* Ensure new vendors and processes achieve required quality, capability, cost, and delivery targets before production release.



  





**8\. Operational Excellence \& Technology** 



* Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Kaizen, automation, and digital manufacturing across internal and external moulding operations.
* Benchmark advanced moulding technologies and global manufacturing practices.
* Promote data\-driven decision\-making and real\-time performance monitoring.
* Drive continuous improvement in OEE, yield, cycle time, scrap, energy consumption, and conversion cost.



  





**9\. People \& Leadership** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team across Moulding Operations, Process Engineering, and Moulding Vendor Development.
* Build strong technical capability in injection moulding, automation, process engineering, supplier development, and external manufacturing.
* Develop a culture of accountability, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and Global Operations.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed institution.
* A postgraduate qualification in Manufacturing, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field is an added advantage.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in high\-volume injection moulding / plastics manufacturing, preferably within automotive, electronics, electrical, connector, or precision component manufacturing.
* Strong hands\-on and leadership experience in vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies, preferably with automated manufacturing systems.



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Moulding OEE and capacity utilization
* Quality / PPM / First\-Pass Yield
* Internal and external moulding productivity
* Cycle\-time and scrap reduction
* Moulding conversion cost
* Vendor Quality and On\-Time Delivery
* Vendor capability and capacity readiness
* Vendor development / localization
* Job\-work and purchase\-model optimization
* Make\-versus\-buy effectiveness
* New product industrialization performance
* Cost\-reduction and productivity savings
* Automation and digitalization deployment
* Supply continuity and alternate\-source readiness

title: Supervising Associate
description:

**The opportunity**
 The Account Manager in GDS is primarily responsible to work closely with UK Account Manager and account leadership to support the planning and implementation of the account activation strategy. **Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support account team in driving service line planning activity and account integration
* Responsible to conduct Account Maturity Assessments and supports in preparation of Account Acceleration sessions
* Prepare the global account meeting materials and facilitate account team meetings
* Responsible for follow\-up on account actions by tracking progress against deadlines and driving activity
* Understand both the client’s business agenda and EY services to enable leveraging the global EY network to connect our clients to the right people
* Develop and manage the account onboarding process and appropriate materials
* Drive the Assessment of Service Quality (ASQ) process: Collate the ASQ feedbacks in Matrix and drive action after interviews and year\-end follow\-up
* Act as a project manager for Account specific initiatives/projects
* Review of account financials to provide awareness to account leadership on drivers of account performance
* Monitoring of operational metrics important to team each month and working with account partners or service line leaders on troubleshooting issues
* Support special projects as needed that require financial data/analysis


**Sales and Program Management:**
* Manage the annual global revenue planning process with the G360 Business Development Leader (BDL) and GCSP
* Own and manage the Client Relationship Management (CRM) process
* Co\-develop the account relationship strategy, including management of the global relationship map
* Manage the account pipeline process and drive discipline across global team
* Coordinate the pursuit process for opportunities, working closely with key partners
* Execute win/loss debriefs
* Identify EY thought leadership and insights to be shared with the client
* Creation and maintenance of account marketing materials (i.e. team brochure discussion relationship history, or Value Scorecard or procurement showcase doc)
* Develop and maintain relationship of Account Managers, Market Segment Managers, to understand latest market\- place, alliance, and solution activity within sector or like accounts


**Information and Knowledge Management**
* Be strategic to collaborate and partner with enabling functions of EY in supporting the account (where applicable):
+ Offshore Account Enablement team in India – pipeline management, financial analysis, sales cycle support, client research, Account plan management
+ EY Knowledge – Account Analysis, Quarterly earnings call summaries, travel packs on client’s business, competitive landscape
+ Finance – Any financial needs of the account
+ Brand, Marketing and Communications – Account specific events, targeted thought leadership
+ Administrative Support – Meeting scheduling and any other administrative tasks
+ Global Sector/Industry – Identify market trends and EY insights
+ Service lines and geographies \- Create process flows required for the team to capture information across account

* Build and manage a repository of team information (i.e. MSA, Rate Card, SOW templates, onboarding documents, team process documents, qualifications, etc) and guide team on how to access and use
* Develop and maintain relationships with the account teams to understand best practices for team information and knowledge management


**Marketing Management**
* Development and execution of account marketing plan to include
* Distribution of thought leadership and/or event invites to relationships targets
+ Alumni relations
+ Support creation and distribution of team communications (i.e. team/client newsletter, WIN announcements)

* Develop and maintain relationships with account teams to understand best practices for marketing activities


**Communications and Administration**
* Serves as subject matter expert for all information related to the account
* Leverage EY resources to support the account
* In consultation with account leadership manages Account specific events, identifies and leverages targeted thought leadership
* Global Sector/Industry \- Identify market trends and EY insights to take to account
* Serve as the knowledge steward of the account and with the assistance of EY Knowledge, connect global team to EY tools and client business issues


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
* May be required to make decisions on behalf of Partners to expedite results
* Influences without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Project Management – experience building and managing project plans
* Presentation/Analysis – experience building .ppt presentations or discussion documents to explain a strategy, process, or relationship history; experience using .xls to analyze data for purpose of generating insights on trends within data set
* Professional maturity to confidently interact with Account Partners. Demonstrate a level of assertiveness, authority while communicating with the Senior Stakeholders and ability to articulate the view points in a succinct manner
* Communication – Demonstrate effective communication at levels of the organization. Understand the nuances, ability to listen effectively, have a global mindset and operate effectively across borders inclusively
* Consultative – demonstrated ability to approach problems and/or projects through effective question/answer techniques to identify needs/issues/desired outcomes and propose solutions to meet needs/issues/desired outcomes
* Emotional Intelligence – demonstrated understanding of different working/personality styles and appreciation of need to flex approach and message to effectively engage
* Networking – demonstrated ability to create networks within a company and use the networks to navigate across an organization for purpose of getting information to answer questions that arise across account
* Ambiguity – personality that is conducive to highly unstructured environments and situations
* Entrepreneur/Proactive behaviors – desire to make the role their own and to create opportunity areas to involve themselves in day\-to\-day operations


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Postgraduate in business management – preferably an MBA
* 7\-8 years working in a professional services firm delivering operational enablement service to teams in different geographies plus previous sales, marketing, business development experience would be preferable


**Certification Requirements**
* Expected to remain current on relevant EY training and curriculum (e.g., Account Management Framework (AMF), Lead Badges, among others


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc
* Credible experience working in a fast\-moving, client\-driven environment


**Technologies and Tools**
* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills \- confidence, maturity \& ability to build strong client relationships


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operations and Control Tower Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an execution\-focused Operations \& Control Tower Lead to manage the operational engine behind our residential rooftop solar deployments.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the central control desk that bridges sales, engineering, local utilities, banks, and the customer. You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.
 



  





 You will also manage a dedicated customer success and coordination team, ensuring homeowners experience proactive, transparent communication from the moment a contract is signed to final commissioning.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Central Order\-to\-Delivery Ownership** 
 : Run the central operations desk tracking residential projects from contract signing through to final commissioning and handoff.
* **Customer Success Desk Management** 
 : Lead and coach a team of customer coordinators/relationship executives. Set clear service\-level agreements (SLAs), communication cadences, and escalation protocols so customers are continuously updated via WhatsApp, calls, and email.
* **Financing \& Banking Coordination** 
 : Work directly with partner banks and NBFCs to track customer solar loan applications, push fast document verification, and secure timely disbursements.
* **Utility \& Regulatory Approvals** 
 : Drive all documentation and registration workflows with local electricity boards (such as KSEB) for initial feasibility approvals, net\-metering allocations, and final site inspections.
* **Government Portal \& Subsidy Management** 
 : Oversee end\-to\-end documentation, portal applications, and compliance filings for central/state solar subsidy programs to achieve zero document rejection rates.
* **Supply Chain \& Field Alignment** 
 : Act as the operational bridge between field sales teams, project engineers, and central inventory. Authorize site dispatch triggers only after ensuring full commercial and documentation clearance.
* **Data \& SLA Tracking** 
 : Maintain absolute data integrity across CRM and operations dashboards. Track and optimize operational metrics, including time\-to\-dispatch, utility approval cycle times, and overall project turnaround times (TAT).
* **Metrics you will own** 
 : Revenue, TAT for financial closure, Outstanding collections
* **Metrics you will be tracking** 
 and influencing the org: Dispatch \& Installation TAT, Overall project TAT, Customer NPS



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Experience** 
 : 10\+ years of hands\-on operations experience in roles such as Project Operations Lead, Order\-to\-Delivery Manager, Operations Control Tower, or Post\-Sales Operations Lead.
* **High bias for action** 
 : Ability to arrive at the next step, given conflicting constraints around the situation, most of the project situations need quick reaction.
* **Domain Familiarity** 
 : Prior experience in residential rooftop solar, retail banking operations (home/consumer loan processing), telecom/broadband network deployments, or high\-value residential installations.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : At least 4\+ years managing a customer support, back\-office operations, or project tracking team.
* **Process Fluency:** 
 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver** 
 : Highly organized individual with strong troubleshooting abilities who can unblock administrative hold\-ups and maintain strict accountability across teams.
* **Languages** 
 : Fluency in Malayalam and English is mandatory to effectively manage local coordination and cross\-functional operations.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation structure.
* Performance bonuses linked to operational velocity, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* A high\-impact role driving the core operational backbone of a fast\-growing residential clean\-tech business.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**NewCo Build**
**Job Description**
**Job Title Change Management Specialist**
**Function: (Category for Job Posting)**
**Job Summary:**
 The Service Management (SM) Change Management Specialist role is responsible for monitoring the ongoing ‘wellnesses of Information Technology (IT) Change Management processes, procedures and policies. The role drives the analytical review of the relevant processes, scheduled reporting and other metrics to confirm that the end\-to\-end processes are operating in a Business as Usual (BAU) mode or to identify exceptions to same. The role leads discussions with Change Lead and /or business leaders on identified process exceptions and recommends potential solutions to rectify breaks in a specific process. The role requires a solid working knowledge of and certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework as part of the role’s core mandate to drive best practices in the alignment of business needs to IT capabilities. The role acts as thought leader in the use of the Service Management tool as trainer to the user population and are advanced users of its monitoring capabilities for IT’s processes. The role may have management responsibility for the Process Analysts who provide the process analytics and is generally guided by the Change Process Lead.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Designs, assesses and delivers the performance analysis of all day\-to\-day Change process under its remit to determine the stability of local, area, global IT applications and the effectiveness of their processes, procedures and policies. Examines Critical Success Factors (CSF), Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and other key metrics produced on a daily, weekly or monthly basis as a critical component of the analysis.
* Defines and coordinates senior level meetings inclusive of monthly services reviews and more frequent meetings to identify root cause of change failures with intent to improve production stability. Identifies change caused outages in co\-ordination with Incident Management and drives input into Continuous Service Improvement and/or Risk Registers.
* Engages with Incident, Problem, Release Management and consults in major outage discussions/meetings as a thought leader on current processes and adds valued insight across senior members of the organization on efforts to restore overall services.
* Actively participates and works with lead/ other stakeholders in design, build and maintenance of CMDB
* Assumes and drives responsibility for escalation actions, as needed, when it is observed that the appropriate IT process is not being adhered to.
* Organizes and leads appropriate post mortem activities with senior members of the organization on Change processes not executed appropriately and drives follow through on actions identified as a result.
* Drives adherence to NewCo build’s compliance standards of IT processes and procedures wherever applicable. Develops and directs practices to improve compliance mandates and/or identifies and implements improvements in process/procedures to support existing compliance directives.
* Leads and coordinates meetings with all levels of the organization directly or under guidance of Lead to review existing KPIs and other metrics aligned to a specific process to drive continued improvements and production stability and/or end user satisfaction. Identifies \& assesses risks, forecasts challenges and opportunities and provides related recommendations including the proposed creation of new KPIs and other modifications based on analysis.
* Engages with vendors for getting root cause and solution of the issues as required.
* Researches, recommends, develops, and implements updates and amendments to the Service Management tool to reflect identified enhancements or changes to process and procedures. Partners with the Quality Management and Automation team to develop and implement necessary modifications to the tool so that it reflects the latest services, procedures and activities.
* Designs and develops training materials, communiques and related documentation to inform and train IT users in the Change process and tool and to embed the process as part of the required business knowledge of the IT organization.
* Ascertains best practices in aligning business needs to an IT organization by maintaining a strong knowledge of industry standards in process management through formal certification and training in the ITIL framework and a knowledge of current and proposed future state of IT processes and procedures
* A good knowledge in dashboards and reporting
* Willingness to work on required automation initiatives and understanding of the same will be added advantage
* Should be willing to work during weekends and in rotational shifts


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires a strong analytical acumen and solution orientation to understand the nuances of Change Management process across cultures and geographic regions as well as within the IT organization. The role additionally requires consultative questioning and influence management skills as well as solid business knowledge of IT services and capabilities to identify the source of a service break and recommend viable solutions that will properly and efficiently resume service delivery.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures

**a) Property Operations**

* Prepare periodic operational, financial, maintenance and compliance reports.

* Planning, coordination and execution.
* Vendor and contract management.
* Budget and cost management.
* Statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Health, safety and security management.
* Negotiation and Relationship management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making.

 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.

 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment.  As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
   

  

 The On\-site Technology Support \- Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM) leader will be responsible for enterprise IT hardware asset management for all Global Delivery Service (GDS) centres globally. The leader will manage the entire IT asset lifecycle including planning, acquiring, deploying, managing, auditing, and retiring for end user asset library (Notebooks, Desktops, Mac, Printers, Audio / Visual equipment, Monitors, Peripherals, Consumables etc..). The person will manage the IT asset management portfolio with respect to business performance, risk, cost, and legal compliance. Driving change, consolidation and service improvement is a key aspect of this role whilst keeping their team motivated in a highly changing, dynamic, diverse, and cross\-cultural environment.

* Mature the ITAM program and create automated and sustainable ITAM operations, enhance and automate, by reducing manual efforts. Propose, plan, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver system automation as per firms’ strategy.
* Interface and collaborate directly with Finance, Procurement, Talent, Legal, Sourcing, Business Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effectiveness of ITAM program.
* Responsible for ensuring quality control throughout the lifecycle of all entity IT assets by developing and implementing appropriate procedures to track and manage them.
* Listen to the voice of the customer and own KPI metrics related to ITAM. Take appropriate action to drive satisfaction and operational excellence.
* Identify opportunities and develop plans for ongoing improvement across IT Asset Management, Configuration Management Database (CMDB) including optimize, re\-harvest, and/or repurpose unused or partially used IT assets, to achieve full efficiency and ROI from company resources.
* Govern and manage Fixed Asset Register (FAR) reconciliation, annual audit compliance, SEZ, regulatory, and customs related process.
* Plan and execute hardware refresh / upgrade programs and ensure availability of minimum inventory of different specifications all locations as per business demand.
* Serve as the single point of contact for all ITAM related contracts and sponsor for IT Asset Management vendor engagements.
* Oversee vendor reseller and OEM engagements to meet established service level targets and key performance indicators.
* Be the face of IT Asset Management to all Business Partners and Executive Leadership. Engage, create, and collaborate on solutions based on business demands.
* Participate in steering committee meeting representing ITAM strategy for Global Delivery Centres.
* Manage and develop IT Asset Lifecycle Management policies, standards, and procedures as per Global ITAM standards and their associated business value.
* Act as a coach to team to deliver scope, meet schedules, balance workload, and resolve roadblocks. Escalate timely to ensure programs and/or services are not jeopardized.
* Establish a service culture with sufficiently ITIL\-educated operations management and staff. Establish and administer the annual budgets and manage expenditures to operate within the approved budget.
* Maintain a high\-level understanding of the business objectives, processes and supporting
* Technology needs of all customers in the Region. Stay sensitive to unique local needs.
* Work with leadership to optimize the business value, quality, and cost of requested services to meet the Firm and EY Technology objectives and policies with a clear articulation of the service levels delivered.
* Collect viewpoints on Technology needs and service issues and communicate these to the appropriate EY Technology leader.
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to define the organization’s asset management \& inventory policy based on industry best practices.
* Demonstrated experience in financial management including budgeting, sourcing, and service costing.
* Understanding of technology and data visualization skills—artificial intelligence, machine learning, Internet of Things, analytics software, and apps.
* Ability to develop \& comprehend the data visualization reports to track orders and shipments, trends, demand and any weaknesses and inefficiencies based on different parameters.
* Advanced analytical skills are required to identify opportunities for service and process improvement across the geography supported.
* Comprehend market economics and dynamics. Predict possible future scenarios by gaining insights into the market trends.
* Work independently with limited oversight from a supervisor.
* High\-level decision\-making responsibilities include the prioritization of work for the IT Asset
* Management function and determining approaches to effectively address service delivery concerns of large customer base.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effectively with escalations, difficult situations and demanding individuals under pressure.
* Co\-ordinate, understand and successfully integrate the activities of a large cross\-cultural, cross\-border team including virtual interaction and ability to travel as per requirement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage all aspects of team management including hiring, development, and counselling.
* High level understanding of SEZ, regulatory, customs, compliance protocols relevant to the role.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 15\+ years of applicable work experience in large multi\-country teams.
* BE\-IT, B.Tech, Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Certification in ITIL \& IT Asset Management preferred
* 5\+ years’ experience of working directly in IT Asset Management role or experience in supply chain management preferred.
* Established experience in vendor relationship management, outsourcing strategy, and e\-waste management.
* Proven track record in leading positive team dynamics that drives efficiencies in throughput.
* Strong organizational, analytic, and complex problem\-solving skills
* Highly effective speaking, listening, writing, project management and interpersonal skills
* Effective communications and collaborative skills with ability to work with management, business and technical leaders and staff of all levels.
* Experience with IT service management tools and/or knowledge of major ITAM products such as Service Now or equivalent.
* Successful candidate will be an energetic passionate leader who demonstrates initiative, and the ability to generate creative solutions and deliver with excellence.
* Exceptional customer service orientation. Work schedule flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

**Continuous learning** 
 : You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

 We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

title: TechOps-SAP-FICO-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SAP FICO Manager \- TechOps \- Application Management \- Consultant**
**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an SAP FICO Manager to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP FICO across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
   

  

 This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best\-in\-class solutions, automation and innovation.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 10\-14 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FICO preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi\-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support SAP FICO module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed\-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross\-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
* Defect resolution and defect analysis related to FICO.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements


**Ideally, you’ll also have:**
* Experience as SME with FICO module (G/L, Account receivable, Accounts Payable, Banking Accounting, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Project System, Results Analysis, Unsettled Costs, Month End \& Year end close, Overhead assessment and settlement)
* Strong knowledge of FI integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in SAP FICO


**What you will do:**
* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FICO solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on\-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What working at EY offers:**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**

* Compliance and Process Adherence: Ensure strict adherence to collections processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Drive compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines.
* Reporting and Analysis: Conduct daily monitoring and regular reviews of the delinquent portfolio. Prepare and present reports on cluster performance, challenges, and proposed solutions.


 Functional Competencies

* Analytical Skills: Use data to drive decision\-making and identify opportunities for process improvements. Analyze collection trends and performance metrics to optimize strategies.
* Communication: Communicate effectively with team members, senior management, and third\-party agencies. Clearly articulate goals, expectations, and performance feedback.

* Strong ability to lead and motivate a team.
* Excellent decision\-making skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.
* Proactive and effective communication skills.

title: SAP FI - FSCM Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Position Title: FSCM \- Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an SAP FSCM Manager, you will lead the financial supply chain management initiatives within the organization, driving improvements in cash flow, credit management, and collections processes. This role offers the chance to oversee the implementation and optimization of SAP FSCM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enhancing overall financial performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leadership: Manage the FSCM team, providing guidance and support to ensure effective execution of financial supply chain strategies.
* Implementation: Oversee the configuration and deployment of SAP FSCM solutions to meet organizational needs.
* Process Improvement: Identify and implement best practices to optimize credit management, collections, and dispute resolution processes.
* Data Analysis: Analyze financial data to provide insights and drive strategic decision\-making.
* Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams to align financial processes with overall business objectives.
* User Training: Develop and deliver training programs for end\-users on FSCM functionalities.
* Troubleshooting: Address and resolve issues related to the FSCM module, ensuring system reliability.

* Key Responsibilities

 Customer and Pricing Strategy:

* organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.

* options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery

* Building bottom\-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter \& month

 Product Understanding

* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact

* Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.

* Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective


**Use of Tools and Systems :**
* Building an understanding of the industry and clients through industry reports, trends, articles and BARC data to know plans of our key clients and categories to pre\-empt the sales team for proactive pitching.
* Analyze market trends, Media performance versus Brand parameters and other critical trends.
* Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients’ buys.
* Deep dive on how advertisers in various sectors buy across genres – understanding the top categories, players, buying mix, impact purchased, channel mix, etc

* Working along with the sales team to ensure revenue targets are met

* Develop a strategy for the next year including customer strategy, pricing strategy and programme wise plans to add up to the channel revenue


**Competitive analysis and Benchmarking –**
* understand what the competition is doing and be agile to take decisions based on Supply, demand and other macro factors

* Liase with programming on the FPC and suggest changes based on the feedback from sales, monetization potential and demand situation.

* Strategic planning
* Influencing Skills
* Result Orientation
* Negotiation Skills
* Analytical thinking
* People management Skill
* Preferred Education \& Experience

* With at least 10\-13 years of post\-qualification experience
